description: This file provides public helper functions and type exports related to speech synthesis, including configuration normalization, cleanup scheduling, and text summarization, for a plugin SDK in a speech processing project.

methods.name: requireInRange
methods.description: Validates that a number is within a specified range, throws an error if not.

methods.name: normalizeLanguageCode
methods.description: Normalizes a language code to lowercase 2-letter ISO format, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeApplyTextNormalization
methods.description: Normalizes the text normalization mode string to 'auto', 'on', or 'off'.

methods.name: normalizeSeed
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a seed number within the allowed range.

methods.name: scheduleCleanup
methods.description: Schedules deletion of a temporary directory after a delay.

methods.name: summarizeText
methods.description: Dynamically imports and calls the summarizeText function from tts-core.js with provided parameters.
